highlights: Pasting a list of domains tells you which ones it skipped. Entries that are not valid domains used to be dropped without a word, so ten pasted domains with two typos ran eight and said nothing about the other two. If none of them is valid, it now says so instead of leaving the Run button to do nothing.

Accent themes: Graphite, Forest and Plum, in Settings → Display. They change the accent only — the colours that mean healthy, warning and critical keep their meanings, because an accent that recoloured them would make the status of a domain harder to read, not easier. Pro+.

Deleting a tracked domain or a workflow is covered by tests now, including that the record of the deletion is written where the next sync will read it. That is the half of syncing where a mistake quietly loses or resurrects your data.
